campaign_trash_retention_check.name: campaign_trash_retention_check
campaign_trash_retention_check.value:
("campaign"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "campaign"."purge_after" IS NULL) OR
    ("campaign"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "campaign"."purge_after" IS NOT NULL
      AND isfinite("campaign"."deleted_at")
      AND "campaign"."purge_after" = (("campaign"."deleted_at" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + interval '30 days') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')

campaign_entity_trash_retention_check.name: campaign_entity_trash_retention_check
campaign_entity_trash_retention_check.value:
("campaign_entity"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "campaign_entity"."purge_after" IS NULL) OR
    ("campaign_entity"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "campaign_entity"."purge_after" IS NOT NULL
      AND isfinite("campaign_entity"."deleted_at")
      AND "campaign_entity"."purge_after" = (("campaign_entity"."deleted_at" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + interval '30 days') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')

change_set_entry_object_identity_check.name: change_set_entry_object_identity_check
change_set_entry_object_identity_check.value: "change_set_entry"."entity_id" IS NOT NULL OR "change_set_entry"."object_id" IS NOT NULL

change_set_entry_operation_snapshot_chec.name: change_set_entry_operation_snapshot_check
change_set_entry_operation_snapshot_chec.value:
("change_set_entry"."operation" = 'INSERT' AND "change_set_entry"."before_json" IS NULL AND "change_set_entry"."after_json" IS NOT NULL) OR
    ("change_set_entry"."operation" = 'UPDATE' AND "change_set_entry"."before_json" IS NOT NULL AND "change_set_entry"."after_json" IS NOT NULL) OR
    ("change_set_entry"."operation" = 'DELETE' AND "change_set_entry"."before_json" IS NOT NULL AND "change_set_entry"."after_json" IS NULL)

command_execution_completion_check.name: command_execution_completion_check
command_execution_completion_check.value:
("command_execution"."status" = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "command_execution"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR
    ("command_execution"."status" = 'SUCCEEDED' AND "command_execution"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
